name: Granite Links Golf Club
aliases: Granite Links Golf Club at Quarry Hills
sourceLabel: Published scorecards reconciled to USGA ratings
cardNote: Granite, Quincy and Milton are three distinct physical nines. Published Granite/Milton, Granite/Quincy and Milton/Quincy scorecards provide the per-nine pars and yardages; the Granite/Quincy totals reconcile to the current USGA rating database. Physical IDs 1–9 are Granite, 10–18 Quincy and 19–27 Milton. The saved Granite/Quincy routing is first and remains the default. Ratings and slopes are omitted from the 27-hole pack because they apply to specific 18-hole combinations, not the aggregate. Retrieved October 28, 2026.
